meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 能执行分子对接：给定蛋白质（PDB 文件或氨基酸序列）和配体（SMILES 或结构文件），预测配体的结合姿态，生成排名后的 3D 结构文件，并给出置信度分数。它还能批量对接多个复合物、进行虚拟筛选并分析结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行蛋白质-小分子对接、预测结合姿态，或提出虚拟筛选、批量对接等任务时触发。需要输入蛋白质结构或序列以及配体描述。

say.text: 把这个配体对接到这个蛋白质上。
say.note: 将运行单次对接并输出排名姿态。

say.text: 对这份化合物列表做虚拟筛选。
say.note: 会准备批次 CSV 并执行批量对接。

say.text: 分析这些对接结果的置信度。
say.note: 会解析置信度分数并输出统计摘要。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can dock small molecules: given a protein (PDB or sequence) and a ligand (SMILES/file), it predicts poses, outputs ranked structures with confidence scores, and supports batch and virtual screening.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to dock a small molecule to a protein, predict binding poses, or run virtual screening / batch docking. Requires protein (PDB or sequence) and ligand (SMILES/SDF/MOL2).

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to this protein.
say_en.note: Runs a single docking and outputs ranked poses.
Prepares a batch CSV and runs batch docking.

say_en.text: Analyze the confidence of these docking results.
say_en.note: Parses confidence scores and produces statistical summaries.
